'''Dmitry Ilyich Dolgopyat''' ({{Langx|ru|Дмитрий Ильич Долгопят}}; born November 1, 1972) is a [[Russian-American]] [[mathematician]] specializing in [[dynamical system]]s,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Dolgopyat Dmitry |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Dolgopyat_Dmitry |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref> a field that studies the time evolution of natural and abstract systems.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Department of Mathematics - Dmitry Dolgopyat Named Distinguished University Professor |url=https://www-math.umd.edu/newsletter-single/986-dmitry-dolgopyat-named-distinguished-university-professor.html |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=www-math.umd.edu}}</ref> An internationally acclaimed lecturer, he holds the position of Distinguished University Professor at the [[University of Maryland]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Department of Mathematics - Dmitry Dolgopyat Named Distinguished University Professor |url=https://www-math.umd.edu/newsletter-single/986-dmitry-dolgopyat-named-distinguished-university-professor.html |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=www-math.umd.edu}}</ref> and is a foreign member of the [[Academia Europaea]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Dolgopyat Dmitry |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Dolgopyat_Dmitry |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>

== Education ==
Dolgopyat graduated from [[Moscow State School 57]] mathematical class in 1989.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://sch57.ru/people/alumni/#y1989|title= Alumni list|publisher=Moscow School 57}}</ref>

From 1989 to 1994, he was an undergraduate student at [[Moscow State University]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.math.umd.edu/~dolgop/vita.html |title=Dmitry Dolgopyat. Resume. |date= |accessdate=2015-08-23}}</ref>

From 1994 to 1997, Dolgopyat was enrolled at [[Princeton University]], where he earned a [[PhD]] under the guidance of [[Yakov Sinai]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=14863 |title=The Mathematics Genealogy Project - Dmitry Dolgopyat |publisher=Genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu |date= |accessdate=2015-08-23}}</ref>

== Career ==
From September 1999 to June 2003, Dolgopyat served as an assistant professor at [[Pennsylvania State University|Penn State University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Dolgopyat Dmitry |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Dolgopyat_Dmitry |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>

Dolgopyat joined the [[University of Maryland, College Park|University of Maryland]] as an associate professor from September 2002 to June 2006. During this period, he also spent a year at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] (IAS) in Princeton (2002-2003).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Dolgopyat Dmitry |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Dolgopyat_Dmitry |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>

He briefly returned to Penn State University as a professor from September 2006 to June 2007 before settling at the University of Maryland as a professor in September 2007, a position he holds to the present day.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Dolgopyat Dmitry |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Dolgopyat_Dmitry |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>

Additionally, Dolgopyat spent a year at the [[University of Toronto]] and the [[Fields Institute]] from 2010 to 2011.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Dolgopyat Dmitry |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Dolgopyat_Dmitry |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>

He has also served on the editorial boards of the [[Journal of Modern Dynamics]], [[Nonlinearity (journal)|Nonlinearity]], [[Ergodic Theory and Dynamical Systems]], [[Annales Henri Poincaré]], and the [[Journal of the American Mathematical Society]], as well as on the Prize Committee of the International [[Bolyai Prize]] Committee.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: CV |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Dolgopyat_Dmitry/CV |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>

== Recognition ==
Dolgopyat was named a Distinguished University Professor in 2022 - the highest academic honor bestowed by the [[University of Maryland, College Park|University of Maryland]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dmitry Dolgopyat Named Distinguished University Professor {{!}} Institute for Physical Science and Technology {{!}} University of Maryland |url=https://ipst.umd.edu/news/dmitry-dolgopyat-named-distinguished-university-professor |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=ipst.umd.edu}}</ref>

In 2020, he was elected a foreign member of the [[Academia Europaea]] - a pan-European Academy of Humanities, Letters, Law, and Sciences.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Dolgopyat Dmitry |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Dolgopyat_Dmitry |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>

In 2009, he was awarded the [[Michael Brin Prize in Dynamical Systems]] for his fundamental contributions to the theory of hyperbolic dynamics.<ref>{{cite web |date= |title=2009 MICHAEL BRIN PRIZE IN DYNAMICAL SYSTEMS |url=http://www.personal.psu.edu/axk29/BrinPrize2.html |accessdate=2015-08-23 |archive-date=2018-08-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180808044601/http://www.personal.psu.edu/axk29/BrinPrize2.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In 2009, Dolgopyat received the [[Annales Henri Poincaré]] Prize for the article Unbounded Orbits for Semicircular Outer Billiard<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Dolgopyat |first1=Dmitry |last2=Fayad |first2=Bassam |date=2009-05-01 |title=Unbounded Orbits for Semicircular Outer Billiard |journal=Annales Henri Poincaré |language=en |volume=10 |issue=2 |pages=357–375 |doi=10.1007/s00023-009-0409-9 |bibcode=2009AnHP...10..357D |issn=1424-0661|doi-access=free }}</ref> coauthored with Bassam Fayad.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Annals (of the Institut) Henri Poincaré |url=https://www.ihp.fr/en/library/annals |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=Institut Henri Poincaré |language=en}}</ref>

Earlier academic honors included the [[Sloan Research Fellowship|Sloan Fellowship]] (Fall 2000 - Spring 2002) and the Miller Fellowship (Fall 1997 - Spring 1999).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Dolgopyat Dmitry |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Dolgopyat_Dmitry |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>

== Guest Lectures and Academic Visits ==
Dolgopyat was an invited speaker at the 2003 [[International Congress on Mathematical Physics]] in Lisbon,<ref>{{Cite web |title=ICMP 2003: Dynamical systems [Sessions] |url=http://icmp2003.net/sessions/ds/ |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=icmp2003.net}}</ref> at the 2006 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Madrid,<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Sanz-Solé |first1=Marta |last2=Soria |first2=Javier |last3=Varona |first3=Juan L. |last4=Verdera |first4=Joan |date=2007-05-15 |title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians Madrid, August 22–30, 2006 |url=https://ems.press/books/standalone/21 |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=ems.press |language=en}}</ref> plenary speaker at the 2006 [[Canadian Mathematical Society]] Winter Meeting in Toronto,<ref>{{Cite web |title=CMS Winter 2006 Meeting |url=https://www2.cms.math.ca/Events/winter06/speakers#plenary |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=www2.cms.math.ca}}</ref> 2009 International Workshop Dynamics Beyond Uniform Hyperbolicity at the [https://bicmr.pku.edu.cn/ Beijing International Center for Mathematical Research],<ref>{{Cite web |title=International Workshop on Global Dynamics Beyond Uniform Hyperbolicity |url=https://www.math.pku.edu.cn/teachers/gansb/conference09/speakers.html |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=www.math.pku.edu.cn}}</ref> and at the 2012 [[International Congress on Mathematical Physics|International Congress in Mathematical Physics]] in Aalborg, Denmark.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Abstracts ICMP Plenary Speakers |url=https://icmp12.aau.dk/abstracts-icmp---plenary-and-topical-sessions/abstracts-icmp-plenary-speakers.aspx.html |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=icmp12.aau.dk}}</ref> delivered mini-courses at the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] in Trieste, Italy,<ref>{{Cite web |last=”Giorgio |title=Workshop on Hyperbolic Dynamics {{!}} (smr 3126) (19-23 June 2017) |url=https://indico.ictp.it/event/7970 |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=Indico - Conferences and Events}}</ref> and at the [http://www.crm.sns.it/ Centro di Ricerca Matematica] [[Ennio De Giorgi]] in Pisa Italy.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Centro di Ricerca Matematica Ennio De Giorgi |url=https://crm.sns.it/event/410/ |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=crm.sns.it}}</ref>

Other longer mini-courses included DANCE (Dynamics, Attractors, Nonlinearity, Chaos & Stability) Winter School in Murcia, Spain, Program on Hyperbolic Dynamics in Vienna, School on Dynamics & Complexity at the [[University of the Republic (Uruguay)]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dynamics & Complexity |url=https://www.fing.edu.uy/~jana/school/school1.htm |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=www.fing.edu.uy}}</ref> Special trimester on dynamical systems in Pisa, Dynamics Beyond Uniform Hyperbolicity in Evanston, with shorter visits to [[University of Manchester|Manchester University]], United Kingdom, [[Centro de Investigación en Matemáticas|Centro de Investigacion en Matematicas]], Guanajuato, Mexico, [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem|Hebrew University]], Jerusalem, Israel, [[Isaac Newton Institute|Newton Institute]], Cambridge, United Kingdom, [[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada|Instituto de Matematica Pura e Aplicada]], Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, [[Northwestern University]], Evanston, Illinois, [[Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa|Scuola Normale]], Pisa, Ecole Polytechnique, [[ETH Zurich|ETH]], Zurich, [[Institute for Advanced Study|IAS]], [[Princeton University|Princeton]], [[California Institute of Technology|CalTech]], [[Research Institute for Mathematical Sciences]], Kyoto, [[Institut Henri Poincaré]], Paris, [[Erwin Schrödinger International Institute for Mathematics and Physics|Erwin Schroedinger Institute]], Vienna, [[Centre International de Rencontres Mathématiques]], Luminy, France, [[University of Toronto]]/ [[Fields Institute]], [[University of Bristol]], [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne|EPFL]], Lausanne, Switzerland, [[Weizmann Institute of Science|Weizmann institute]], Israel, [[Institute for Computational and Experimental Research in Mathematics]], Providence, RI.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: CV |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Dolgopyat_Dmitry/CV |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>
